initialExam.title: NIACL AO (Administrative Officer) 2026
initialExam.description: NIACL AO recruitment for administrative officers in India's largest general insurance company.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: Reasoning (35Q), English (30Q), Quant (35Q). Mains: Reasoning (40Q), English (40Q), Quant (40Q), GK (40Q) + Descriptive English.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 100Q, 100 marks, 1 hour. Mains: 160Q + Descriptive, 200+30 marks. Interview.
initialExam.jobRole: Administrative Officer in New India Assurance
initialExam.careerGrowth: AO → Deputy Manager → Manager → Senior Manager → Chief Manager → AGM → DGM → GM.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit newindia.co.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical Insurance, Pension, LFC, Performance bonus
